entities.summary: Nathan Blecharczyk is the co-founder and chief strategy officer (CSO) of Airbnb, and chairman of Airbnb China. Blecharczyk was also the company's first chief technology officer. Blecharczyk is the 203rd richest person in the world according to Forbes, with a net worth of $9.4 billion, mostly due to his ownership of 62 million shares of Airbnb.
